sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Burn damage support with consistent tile generation, damage boost buffs, damage mitigation, debuff cleansing, and decent personal damage output. At V2+, Loreley can be a good flex support pick for mixed element teams.

Change Glowing Embers to increase all damage dealt by 45%. Increased number of Immaculate Flame procs per turn.

Increased Searing Flame accumulation on summon. Increased Whippoorwill Pulse damage and adds a ramping damage boost and critical damage boost to Loreley based on number of Whippoorwill Pulse triggers.

Additional Searing Flame accumulation at the start of battle. Enhanced Attack buff from Burning Tide. Loreley gets increased Attack per Burn-type doll present. Enhances damage taken reduction from Glowing Embers.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Tons of utility but a lot of it is tied to the Embers Burn mechanic, although Loreley generates plenty of Searing Flame by herself. At V2, the damage boost from Glowing Embers becomes generic, justifying her inclusion in non-mono-Burn teams. No healing but damage avoidance and reduction effects can help with survivability. There's some overlap with Vector, but they each have plenty of non-overlapping utility to justify running both in a mono-Burn team.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: No utility scaling off of Defense or Health. Build her like a Burn DPS.
